(2) with the main article Table I central 298 K coefficients (rho0=8.939 g/cm3, K0=133.6 GPa, eta=6.29, beta=2.06, psi=1.65). Each target volume is paired with the Cu volume from the same experiment and run; no unpublished pressure weights or covariance are inferred.

assessment.basis: Direct reconstruction from source observations: each Table S1 phase volume is paired with its simultaneous Cu volume, pressure is evaluated from Fratanduono et al.'s analytic third-order 298 K Vinet fit, and K0 and K0_prime are fitted with Shen and Smith's fixed V0 and stated run selection. The source publishes no pressure weights, residual covariance, or weighting protocol, so the reproduction uses unweighted pressure residuals and does not infer any of them. The paper identifies Table II as direct fits to this study's Cu-referenced P-V data, with earlier literature included for comparison. Its data-availability statement also mentions other author-held data, so completeness of the actual author fit inputs is unconfirmed. No additional experimental fit rows are identified by the published fitting description. See the [source-input audit](literature-reproductions/shen-smith-2026-cu-refits.md). Not recommended for scientific predictions or pressure calibration. Retained only for explicit diagnostic inspection. The published fixed-V0 NaCl-B2 Vinet curve gives 0.622381 GPa pressure RMS and mean residual -0.547610 GPa on 125 DAC-2 Table S1 observations above 35 GPa; all 125 residuals are negative. A direct unweighted refit gives K0=25.447259 GPa, K0_prime=5.582768 and RMS 0.293229 GPa, versus published 24.92 GPa and 5.63. The source-fit discrepancy is unresolved; including the above-33-GPa transition rows does not restore agreement.
